formal_scope.scope_rule: This field-acceptance framework admits formal-replay data only for the listed instrument classes. Other instruments, proxies and substitutions are out of scope unless the formal scope is separately amended and re-gated.

objective: A unitized, scale-neutral, ex-post replay of predeclared rolling five-year cohorts in the formal scope using net time-weighted total return. No allocation, product selection, cash-income objective, automatic reinvestment assumption, or execution authorization is created.
entitlement_boundary: No subscription, licence, API right, authorized vendor relationship, or right to archive/derive/redistribute data is asserted by this research. Each must be evidenced before ingesting data for a formal replay.

coverage_documented: bond basic information and market statistics
official_documentation_evidence.formal_replay_boundary: A public catalogue establishes that the fields are disclosed; it does not evidence a contractually authorized historical PIT archive, a service level, revision history, bulk-download right, or derived-data right.

official_documentation_evidence.source: Shenzhen Stock Exchange technical services page
official_documentation_evidence.formal_replay_boundary: This documentation does not demonstrate that this research has permission to ingest, retain, or derive a complete PIT history for Shenzhen-listed instruments.

coverage_documented: daily closing total-return and net-total-return index variants
scheduled constituent review and temporary maintenance
official_documentation_evidence.formal_replay_boundary: An index methodology is suitable to test index-event and dividend conventions. It does not evidence product-level investor return, executable cost, or access to a versioned historical constituent and index data archive.

coverage_documented: interbank bond-market quotation, basic, benchmark, historic and trade-related market data
official_documentation_evidence.formal_replay_boundary: CFETS states that use requires an application and written licence/authorization, and restricts copying, saving, use and derived work without written permission. Thus public notices cannot be substituted for licensed historical bond pricing or quote data.

official_documentation_evidence.source: ChinaBond indices legal notice and data instructions
coverage_documented: reference to ChinaBond data products and authorized data vendors
official_documentation_evidence.formal_replay_boundary: ChinaBond requests separate written application for use of its information products or indices in product/benchmark contexts and directs users to additional data products or authorized vendors for more detail. Formal ingestion requires a written-use and retention-right confirmation for the exact fields and purpose.

official_documentation_evidence.source: ChinaClear Beijing market data interface specification
official_documentation_evidence.formal_replay_boundary: The captured document is a clearing-participant interface specification. It proves field semantics, not public access or research entitlement to a historical event archive.

field_acceptance_matrix.field_group: PIT security master and eligible-universe history
field_acceptance_matrix.officially_documented_or_publicly_reconc: SSE public catalogue documents stock/fund/bond lists and suspended/terminated listings; SZSE publishes market-data technical services. Issuer and exchange disclosures can reconcile individual changes.
field_acceptance_matrix.requires_authorized_or_licensed_archive: Yes. A formal replay needs a complete versioned historical master and contemporaneous availability timestamps, not a current web list.
acceptance_evidence: coverage inventory by venue and instrument
written right to store and derive internal research outputs

minimum_fields: legal/operational access classification and status flag
remaining term or taxonomy-coded not-applicable state
duration value and duration definition or taxonomy-coded not-applicable state
valuation-staleness flag, valuation timestamp and applicable staleness threshold
field_acceptance_matrix.officially_documented_or_publicly_reconc: Issuer, manager, exchange and market-infrastructure disclosures can reconcile isolated maturity, duration, event and valuation facts. They do not establish a complete PIT selector input history or the contemporaneous freshness state required at every t.
field_acceptance_matrix.requires_authorized_or_licensed_archive: Yes. A formal replay requires an entitled PIT field history that permits PL(t) to be evaluated at each cohort-formation and rebalance timestamp without carrying forward unstated values.
acceptance_evidence: field dictionary defining the formal-scope, legal/operational-access and default-like/credit-event classifications
taxonomy-approved not-applicable codes by instrument class
PIT source timestamps and revision history
event and valuation staleness thresholds with raw supporting timestamps
sample reconstruction of PL(t) at multiple historical dates

field_acceptance_matrix.officially_documented_or_publicly_reconc: Fund/REIT legal documents, issuer disclosures, exchange notices and individual project disclosures can reconcile selected relationships and ownership facts. They do not establish a complete versioned relationship graph or a stable cross-source aggregation taxonomy.
field_acceptance_matrix.requires_authorized_or_licensed_archive: Yes. A formal replay requires an entitled, versioned PIT relationship and constituent archive that supports issuer, controller and look-through aggregation at every t.
acceptance_evidence: identifier crosswalk with source-specific IDs and effective dates
historical constituent/weight snapshots with residual-weight treatment
aggregation taxonomy/version, including 20% issuer/controller/look-through bucket rules
sample cap reconstruction at multiple historical dates

field_acceptance_matrix.field_group: A-share and listed ETF/public-REIT EOD market data
field_acceptance_matrix.officially_documented_or_publicly_reconc: SSE public catalogue identifies market-price, fund and public-REIT information; SSE/SZSE public pages can reconcile sampled prices and market status.
field_acceptance_matrix.requires_authorized_or_licensed_archive: Yes for a complete, versioned, reproducible PIT EOD archive and any required historical market-data use rights. Public observation is only a reconciliation/discovery layer.
acceptance_evidence: field-level vendor coverage confirmation for SSE and SZSE
sample reconciliation to official exchange page

field_acceptance_matrix.field_group: Corporate actions, cash distributions and non-standard events
field_acceptance_matrix.officially_documented_or_publicly_reconc: Exchange and issuer disclosures are primary event evidence. ChinaClear's interface specification documents fields for equity distributions, interest and bond redemption, and conversions.
field_acceptance_matrix.requires_authorized_or_licensed_archive: Yes for normalized, comprehensive historical coverage. The participant specification does not convey a public historical-event entitlement.

minimum_fields: official NAV and accumulated NAV date
REIT project capital event and offering terms
field_acceptance_matrix.officially_documented_or_publicly_reconc: SSE public catalogue documents ETF creation-redemption lists and public-REIT NAV/market information. Fund managers and REIT managers publish legal documents, NAV/distribution and project-event disclosures.
field_acceptance_matrix.requires_authorized_or_licensed_archive: Yes for a complete PIT archive that joins product mechanics with exchange prices and preserves document availability time. Public manager/exchange documents remain the primary reconciliation source.

field_acceptance_matrix.officially_documented_or_publicly_reconc: Ministry of Finance and CFETS/ChinaMoney notices can establish issuance, coupon and redemption terms. CFETS documents broad interbank market-data coverage, including historic data. ChinaBond publicly displays selected valuations and index information.
field_acceptance_matrix.requires_authorized_or_licensed_archive: Yes. CFETS expressly requires written authorization for use of its market data. ChinaBond documentation directs users to licensed data products or authorized vendors for more detail; exact use, retention and derivation rights must be documented.
acceptance_evidence: ChinaBond data-use confirmation if ChinaBond pricing/index data are used

field_acceptance_matrix.officially_documented_or_publicly_reconc: CSI methodology documents daily close TRI/NTRI calculation, before-tax/after-tax dividend treatment and constituent-maintenance mechanics.
field_acceptance_matrix.requires_authorized_or_licensed_archive: Usually yes for a complete historical constituent and value archive. Methodology access does not establish a data-download, retention or derived-use entitlement.
acceptance_evidence: index provider's coverage and usage confirmation

field_acceptance_matrix.officially_documented_or_publicly_reconc: Exchange fee/tax rules and product documents can support selected mechanics. SSE/SZSE and CFETS documentation identifies market-data channels; individual disclosures can reconcile event dates.
field_acceptance_matrix.requires_authorized_or_licensed_archive: Yes. Historical executable quotes/depth and actual applicable fee terms are not established by public product disclosures. The replay must use an authorized broker fee schedule and an entitled market-data source.
acceptance_evidence: licensed EOD/intraday quote coverage where used

field_acceptance_matrix.field_group: PIT availability, provenance and audit trail
minimum_fields: source URL or vendor request ID
field_acceptance_matrix.officially_documented_or_publicly_reconc: Official disclosures expose individual publication dates and documents, but do not by themselves supply a complete machine-readable availability/revision archive.
field_acceptance_matrix.requires_authorized_or_licensed_archive: Yes. The data owner/provider must attest field coverage, publication lag, corrections and archive retrieval rights.

hard_field_level_acceptance_block.rule: At every cohort-formation, rebalance and valuation timestamp t, PL(t) and the 20% issuer/controller/look-through cap assessment must use the exact PIT fields below. A PL(t) candidate must have a versioned formal-scope classification that is one of A-shares, listed ETFs, public REITs or direct sovereign/interbank bonds. A field is acceptable only when it is populated from an entitled source or explicitly taxonomy-coded not-applicable with a documented source basis; an unknown, carried-forward, stale, unmapped or unversioned value is a missing field.

protected_liquidity_selector_fields.requirement: PIT instrument-class classification, taxonomy version and source linking the candidate to exactly one permitted formal-scope class: A-shares, listed ETFs, public REITs or direct sovereign/interbank bonds.

PIT legal/operational access definition, classification and status flag for the stated venue/route, with source, effective timestamp and revision history. The flag must distinguish eligible, restricted, suspended, unavailable and unknown states; it does not assert that this research has data or trading entitlement.

PIT definition, status flag, source-event timestamp and revision history for default-like or credit-event states, including a source-coded not-applicable state only where the instrument taxonomy permits it.

Remaining contractual term measured at t, with maturity/redemption date and calculation convention; use a documented not-applicable code only where the instrument taxonomy makes the field inapplicable.
Duration value, definition, source date and effective timestamp at t; use a documented not-applicable code only where the instrument taxonomy makes the field inapplicable.
PIT flag, threshold, latest relevant event timestamp and source status showing whether a material event record is stale, pending, corrected or unavailable at t.
PIT flag, threshold, valuation/NAV/price timestamp, valuation source and revision status showing whether the valuation input is stale at t.

common_risk_look_through_mapping_fields.requirement: Stable identifiers for issuer, guarantor, controller and beneficial owner, each with relationship role, effective dates, source and revision history.
PIT underlying constituent identifiers, weights, effective date, total-coverage check and residual-weight treatment for every relevant listed ETF or public REIT.
PIT identifiers and effective dates for each applicable fund/REIT sponsor, manager, project, tenant, offtaker and refinancing counterparty, with relationship role and source.
Versioned crosswalk joining venue security IDs, fund/REIT IDs, issuer/entity IDs, project IDs and counterparty IDs, with effective dates and source lineage.
Versioned aggregation taxonomy defining issuer, controller and look-through buckets, relationship hierarchy, alias treatment, control/beneficial-owner treatment and the 20% cap calculation rule.

hard_field_level_acceptance_block.cohort_failure: If any required applicable field lacks an entitled PIT value, an accepted taxonomy-coded not-applicable state, a valid formal-scope classification, a legal/operational-access classification, a default-like/credit-event state, a valid identifier crosswalk, or a current aggregation-taxonomy version at t, the affected cohort is blocked. An out-of-scope candidate also blocks the cohort. It may not be partially admitted, proxy-filled, carried forward or treated as passing the 20% issuer/controller/look-through caps.

hard_acceptance_gates.must_pass: Written evidence names the authorized user, provider or authorized intermediary, asset classes, exact fields, historical and PIT coverage, purpose of internal unitized research replay, retention period, archival permission, derived-output permission, redistribution prohibition, user/API limits and expiry.
hard_acceptance_gates.failure: Do not ingest as formal-replay data; retain q=0.

hard_acceptance_gates.must_pass: One source hierarchy covers every matrix field for the formal scope only: A-shares, listed ETFs, public REITs and direct sovereign/interbank bonds, with a documented fallback that does not change return convention.
hard_acceptance_gates.failure: No formal replay; an uncovered event or field blocks the affected cohort.

hard_acceptance_gates.must_pass: For each applicable instrument and timestamp t, the hard field-level acceptance block supplies a formal-scope classification within the four permitted classes, legal/operational-access classification, default-like/credit-event state, remaining term, duration, event/valuation-staleness flags, relationship identities, underlying weights, fund/REIT relationship fields, identifier crosswalk and aggregation taxonomy/version. The exact PL(t) and 20% issuer/controller/look-through rule must be reproducible from those versioned fields.
hard_acceptance_gates.failure: The affected cohort is blocked. No out-of-scope candidate, proxy, stale carry-forward, partial look-through or unversioned aggregation may be used; retain q=0.

hard_acceptance_gates.must_pass: Every input has both as_of and available_at; announcements, revisions, membership changes, halts and event records are retrievable in historical versions and stored with raw hashes.
hard_acceptance_gates.failure: No PIT claim; no formal replay.

hard_acceptance_gates.must_pass: Raw prices plus the complete event ledger, or one verified total-return source, are reconciled across samples of cash distribution, share action, rights/non-standard event, fund/REIT distribution, halt/limit lock and bond coupon/redemption without double counting.
The scale-neutral engine applies the then-effective authorized fee/tax inputs and a frozen, entitled quote/spread/slippage method. It records settlement and no-fill states without synthetic fills.
hard_acceptance_gates.failure: Cost-aware TWRR not testable; retain q=0.

hard_acceptance_gates.must_pass: A second reviewer can recreate a selected cohort from immutable raw records, rulebook version and manifests, and can identify every source, revision and field transformation.

can_do: reconcile sampled market status and corporate events
supply fund/REIT/issuer notices and official dates
document CSI dividend and corporate-action convention
document that SSE publicly discloses relevant categories
cannot_do_alone: prove authorization to bulk ingest/store/derive historical market data
supply a complete revisioned PIT archive for the formal scope
supply the dynamic PL(t) inputs or the versioned issuer/controller/look-through graph required for 20% caps
supply historical executable bid/ask or fill-quality data
convert fund NAV, coupon, distribution rate or index methodology into investor cost-aware TWRR

next_authorized_probe: Obtain written entitlement evidence before any protected data request.

Request a field-level coverage statement and schema sample from the proposed authorized source or intermediary, including the PL(t), relationship-graph, identifier-crosswalk and aggregation-taxonomy fields.
Run a six-event reconciliation pilot only after acceptance of entitlement: cash dividend, share action, rights/non-standard event, ETF/REIT distribution, halt/limit lock and bond coupon/redemption.
Reconstruct PL(t) and the 20% issuer/controller/look-through mapping at multiple historical timestamps before evaluating a cohort.
Archive each raw response with source owner, as_of, available_at, retrieval timestamp, licence reference and SHA-256.
conclusion: Public official sources are sufficient for structure/event reconciliation and for defining required fields. They are insufficient to establish an authorized PIT total-return replay for A-shares, listed ETFs, public REITs and direct sovereign/interbank bonds. No entitlement is evidenced, the protected-liquidity and look-through field block is not passed, q remains 0, and the formal unitized scale-neutral replay remains blocked.
